claims.claim_vi: Static algorithms: round robin sends client requests to different service instances in sequential order, usually requiring stateless services.
claims.verified_by: Source body read from the pinned commit; the statement is in the source text.

claims.claim_vi: Sticky round-robin improves round robin: if Alice's first request goes to service A, her following requests go to A as well.
claims.verified_by: Source body read from the pinned commit; the statement is in the source text.

claims.claim_vi: Weighted round-robin: the admin specifies a weight for each service; higher-weight services handle more requests.
claims.verified_by: Source body read from the pinned commit; the statement is in the source text.

claims.claim_vi: Hash applies a hash function on the incoming request's IP or URL and routes requests to the relevant instances based on the result.
claims.verified_by: Source body read from the pinned commit; the statement is in the source text.

claims.claim_vi: Dynamic algorithms: least connections sends a new request to the instance with the least concurrent connections; least response time to the instance with the fastest response time.
claims.verified_by: Source body read from the pinned commit; the statement is in the source text.

claims.claim_vi: nginx distributes requests by weighted round-robin by default; server weight defaults to 1; the example with weights 5, 1, 1 sends 5 of 7 requests to the first server and one each to the others.
claims.verified_by: Read from a raw copy at the pinned commit in the URL (a later change to the default branch does not alter it).

claims.claim_vi: nginx ip_hash distributes by client IP address so requests from the same client reach the same server unless it is unavailable; hash distributes by a hashed key; least_conn passes a request to the server with the least number of active connections taking weights into account; sticky enables session affinity.
claims.verified_by: Read from a raw copy at the pinned commit in the URL (a later change to the default branch does not alter it).

claims.claim_vi: nginx least_time passes a request to the server with the least average response time and is part of the commercial subscription.
claims.verified_by: Read from a raw copy at the pinned commit in the URL (a later change to the default branch does not alter it).

claims.claim_vi: The source gives no guidance on when to pick which algorithm, no measurements and no definition of static versus dynamic; the glosses of IP and URL are the author's general knowledge.
claims.verified_by: Author's general knowledge; not checked against primary documentation.

design_notes_vi: Hai nhóm thẻ (bốn thuật toán tĩnh, hai thuật toán động) và một khung ghi nhớ, giữ thứ tự của nguồn. Không dùng ảnh nguồn.

nginx behavior is not in the source and comes from the pinned nginx documentation; the source does not define static or dynamic, which the lesson keeps as the source's labels.
